### A Church with Resilience and Charm
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/article-library/individual/a-church-with-resilience-and-charm
Passage: Acts 9:31
Points:
- The early church exhibited remarkable resilience, flourishing in peace and expanding despite constant persecution.
- Believers sustained momentum through four key qualities: being steadfast, immovable, joyful, and confident.
- Alongside resilience, the church possessed an irresistible charm grounded in authentic grace and love.
- Harsh legalism drives people away, whereas gracious living draws others toward righteousness.
- Modern congregations must cultivate welcoming environments where people can freely bring their hurts, questions, and needs.
